description: This file defines a final class `SimpleFileWatcher` that manages a `CoalescingFSEventsWatcher` instance to start and stop file system event watching.

classes.name: SimpleFileWatcher
classes.description: A wrapper class that manages the lifecycle of a `CoalescingFSEventsWatcher` instance to observe file system changes.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up by stopping the watcher when `SimpleFileWatcher` is deallocated.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the file system event watcher.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the file system event watcher.
